question: The FIFA World Cup 2026 will be hosted by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Canada, USA, and Mexico__.**

__
 
• FIFA World Cup 2026 will be held in **Canada, the USA, and Mexico**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The 2026 FIFA World Cup will be the 23rd FIFA World Cup tournament and it will be hosted in Canada, Mexico, and the United States.
 
• The first football club in the world ‘Sheffield Football Club’ was founded in the year 1857 in England. 
 
• The first football club in India, named '*Calcutta FC*', was founded in 1872.
 
• The apex institution of football is ‘The Federation of International formed by seven countries on May 21, 1904.
 
• 
 
The headquarters of FIFA is in Zürich, Switzerland.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Football was included as a competitive game in the Olympic Games officially in 1908.
 
• India took part in the World Olympic Football Competition in 1948 in London.
 
• The first World Cup was organized at Monte (Uruguay) in 1930. 
 
• In India, the Indian Football Association (IFA) organizes the National Football Championship.
 
 
• The trophy awarded in their competition is called the Santosh Trophy.
